Subject: Orchid AI — Procurement activation & tax docs needed

Hi Elena,

Thanks for selecting Redwood for the integration. To enable PO creation and payments we need a short set of onboarding items from Orchid AI. Our finance team will validate these before we issue a PO.

Please provide the following by EOD Wednesday (May 5):

- Signed W-9 (for US entities) or completed W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities)
- VAT registration certificate (if applicable)
- Legal company name and registration address exactly as it should appear on the PO
- Remittance bank details (account number, routing/IBAN/SWIFT) and a voided check or bank letter
- Tax identification / EIN / VAT number
- Preferred invoice email and contact person

Preferred delivery: upload PDFs to the secure folder (link below) or reply to this thread with attachments. If you prefer DocuSign, I can send the supplier agreement link.

Links:
- Supplier DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/supplier-agreement/6f7c8
- Secure intake folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-Procurement/OrchidAI

Next steps once we receive and validate the docs:
1) Finance (Monica) validates tax docs and bank details.
2) We create a PO and share the PO number.
3) You begin invoicing against the PO.

If any of the items require more time, tell me which one and an ETA and we'll adjust.

Best,

Connor O'Brien

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these.

We received the W-9, VAT certificate, and bank letter. A couple of quick items before we can finalize:

- Digital signature on W-9 is acceptable for us, but we need the form to show the company's legal name exactly as registered (currently shows "OrchidAI, Inc" — please confirm that's the correct legal name for tax purposes). If there is any discrepancy, please resend a corrected W-9.
- Please confirm the entity type on the W-9 (C-Corp, S-Corp, LLC taxed as ...). You mentioned C-Corporation — please reply and confirm.
- For bank verification, can you provide a voided check or bank letter that lists the account holder name and account number on bank letterhead? The uploaded bank letter is acceptable but the voided check speeds up our ACH setup.

Once we have these confirmations, I will create PO RED-2027-0893 (expected by EOD Thursday) and confirm payment terms (Net 30 unless otherwise agreed).

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Finance Manager — Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
